# Pooch Professional Grooming Services - Altona North

> Pooch Professional Grooming Services, located at 3 Misten Avenue in Altona North, offers a variety of dog grooming treatments tailored to different coat lengths and sizes. Services range from full grooms and beauty baths to de-shed treatments and nail clips.
